4681-5170-7272-8292.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
4681-5170-7272-8292.description:
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Massacre Girl triggers, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Massacre Girl trigger.
Resolve the Massacre Girl trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Reaper of Flight Moonsilver ability, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

3234-3293-4247-6620.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
3234-3293-4247-6620.description:
Activate Sylvan Safekeeper by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat
3234-3293-4247-6620.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

728-1981-2415-5933.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Popular Egotist and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain life and an opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

5078-6747-7902.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Sami.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Fateful Discovery triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Fateful Discovery trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat

147-4875-7884.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Sygg's Command
147-4875-7884.description:
Cast Sygg's Command by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Sygg's Command, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Sygg's Command, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.
147-4875-7884.notes: When choosing modes, the other mode you choose will net additional results.

1978-3941-7714.easyPrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in your library
1978-3941-7714.description:
Cast Coveted Jewel by paying its mana cost.
When Coveted Jewel enters, it and Ultron trigger.
Resolve the Coveted Jewel trigger, causing you to draw three cards.
Holding priority, activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Resolve the Ultron trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a copy of Coveted Jewel that is a 2/2 Robot Villain creature.
When the Coveted Jewel token enters, it triggers, causing you to draw three cards.
During your next turn, activate the Coveted Jewel token by tapping it, adding three mana of any color
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the Coveted Jewel token.
Repeat from step 7.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-4661-6558.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-4661-6558.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Naga Fleshcrafter and Vesuvan Doppelganger each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Naga Fleshcrafter trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Vesuvan Doppelganger trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-4661-6558.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

1618-2440-4146-7376.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Murmuring Mystic
1618-2440-4146-7376.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Charnel Serenade.
Charnel Serenade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Murmuring Mystic triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Charnel Serenade.
Repeat.
1618-2440-4146-7376.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Murmuring Mystic. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

3398-5334-7025.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Hellkite Charger
3398-5334-7025.description:
Declare Hellkite Charger as an attacker, triggering it once and Avatar Roku twice.
Resolve both Avatar Roku triggers, adding twelve {R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1879-5921-5970-7014.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of North Pole Patrol.
Activate one of the North Pole Patrol tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other North Pole Patrol token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

3075-3368-6974.notablePrerequisites: You have at least fthree experience counters
3075-3368-6974.description:
Cast Ashling's Command by paying {U}{R} due to Mizzix of the Izmagnus. Choose its fourth mode targeting yourself and then any other mode as desired.
If you had exactly three experience counters. Mizzix of the Izmagnus triggers, giving you an experience counter.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {R}{R} due to Mizzix of the Izmagnus, copying Ashling's Command with the fourth mode targeting yourself and returning Reiterate to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Ashling's Command, creating two Treasure tokens and performing the action of the other chosen mode.
Holding priority, activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.

4050-5276-6767.description:
Cast Leonin Relic-Warder by paying {W}{W}.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Leonin Relic-Warder.
When Leonin Relic-Warder dies, its second ability triggers, returning Rescue Skiff from exile to the battlefield.
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Leonin Relic-Warder from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Leonin Relic-Warder enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Rescue Skiff.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-5500-6965.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5500-6965.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Seraphic Steed as attackers.
Seraphic Steed triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1879-2034-5003-6773.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers. Choose not to pay.
Activate Xu-Ifit by tapping it, returning a creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Xu-Ifit, adding {C}{C}.
When Xu-Ifit dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return it from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

3129-4321-5777-6451.description:
Activate Camellia by paying {2} and sacrificing a Food.
Camellia's first ability triggers, creating two Foods and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Resolve the Camellia ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on each other Squirrel you control.
Activate the two Foods by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

2281-4050-6598.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting General Leo Cristophe.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing General Leo Cristophe.
When General Leo Cristophe dies, Saffi triggers, returning General Leo Cristophe from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When General Leo Cristophe enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2594-2634-5148.notablePrerequisites: You control a basic Mountain, a basic Island and at least three other basic lands.
2594-2634-5148.description:
Activate Winding Canyons by paying {2} and tapping it, allowing you to cast creature spells as though they have flash this turn.
Activate any number of basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Early Harvest by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Early Harvest
Resolve the Early Harvest copy, untapping all basic lands you control.
Activate any number of basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.

2178-4681-5256-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 4.
2178-4681-5256-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with mana value 4.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Karmic Guide enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 4 from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

2047-2707-4377-6504.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Walk the Aeons each turn.
2047-2707-4377-6504.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Mechanized Production triggers, creating a token copy of Conjurer's Bauble.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate the Conjurer's Bauble token by tapping and sacrificing it, putting Walk the Aeons onto the bottom of your library from your graveyard, and then causing you to draw Walk the Aeons from the bottom of your library due to River Song.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with at least one +1/+1 counter on it

276-4120-4968.description:
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Deathbringer Thoctar by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat as desired.
276-4120-4968.notes: You may target a creature you control in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.

457-712-4824.description:
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Soliton, adding {U}.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Wake Thrasher triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.

372-2187-3647.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Displace exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2187-3647.description:
Cast Displace by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Possessed Skaab and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Possessed Skaab trigger.
Resolve the Possessed Skaab trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Displace.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Possessed Skaab and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

2781-3293-5256.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying {3}{W}.
Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, blinking Plains.
Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Felidar Guardian, causing target player to mill one card.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

1183-2557-2757.description:
Activate Earthcraft by tapping Pentavus, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate a basic land you control by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Pentavus' first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two 1/1 Pentavite creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Pentavite, untapping a basic land you control.
Activate a basic land you control by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate Pentavus' second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing a Pentavite, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pentavus.
Repeat from step 3.

1766-1978-3007.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1766-1978-3007.description:
Animate Thran Dynamo using Toymaker.
Activate Thran Dynamo by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Thran Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.
